name: claude-drain-guard
description: Real-time, five-minute Claude Code drain and prompt-cache anomaly alerts.

commands.title: Claude Drain Guard: Connect Live Usage
Claude Drain Guard: Generate Incident Report
Claude Drain Guard: Mute Alerts for 15 Minutes

claudeDrainGuard.dataDirectory.description: Claude config directory. Empty uses CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude.

claudeDrainGuard.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Background refresh interval in seconds. File changes are also detected immediately.

claudeDrainGuard.absoluteCacheFloorPerce.description: Cold-start safety floor used only before enough personal cache history exists.

claudeDrainGuard.modalCriticalAlerts.description: Require acknowledgement for critical drain events.

claudeDrainGuard.autoGenerateCriticalRep.description: Generate a local Markdown evidence report for every critical incident.

claudeDrainGuard.authoritativeQuota.enab.description: Read authoritative 5h/7d usage from Claude Code's OAuth usage endpoint or passively observe the official extension's response. No model prompt is sent. Disable for local-only monitoring.

claudeDrainGuard.authoritativeQuota.cred.description: Optional Claude credentials file. Empty uses the selected Claude data directory/.credentials.json.

claudeDrainGuard.authoritativeQuota.slic.description: Critical alert when authoritative 5h utilization rises by this many percentage points between five-minute snapshots.

claudeDrainGuard.cost.fallbackCacheTtl.description: Cache-write TTL used only when Claude Code omits the 5m/1h breakdown. Auto follows ccusage's conservative standard 5m cache-write fallback; choose 1h only when you know the request used it.
